children: Bionano reported Q2 2026 revenue of $8.2M, raised FY26 guidance and outlined FY27 revenue target of $50–54M with projected EBITDA break‑even in Q4 FY27.
Chairman and interim CEO presented at H.C. Wainwright conference; presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to the 8‑K.
Q2 revenue $8.2M beat guidance; raised FY26 lower bound to $31–33M; 53% adjusted gross margin in Q2.
Retired JGB debt secured by $10.3M restricted cash; cash OPEX burn improved to $1.2M in Q2.
FY27 guidance: $50–54M revenue, 48–55 new instrument placements, and ~0 adj. EBITDA exit rate in Q4 FY27.
Commercial progress: two AMA CPT codes for OGM, MolDX LCD public comment for Medicare coverage, and NY state lab approval enabling MSKCC testing.
